name: Yae Sakura
source: Yae Sakura is a maiden in a small Japanese village 500 years ago. By chance, Kallen Kaslana, who had fled to the village, was infected by the crystal that she carried to seal the Houkai, and became an existence similar to the Herrscher. Sakura was later sealed by Kallen. It wasn't until the third Houkai occurred 500 years later that she was released from the seal. Defeated by Kiana in Nagazora City, currently missing...
